finding: Slovak firms reported a net 43.8% experiencing interest rate tightening in wave 39
bullets: A net 43.8% of Slovak firms (n=76) reported tighter interest rates, rising 38.3 pp from a net 5.5% in the previous wave, now above the EA (net 40.0%) and DE (net 42.5%) — increasing debt servicing costs.

A net 12.4% of Slovak firms (n=74) reported smaller available loan or credit line sizes, rising 6.3 pp from the previous wave, exceeding the EA (net 9.1%) and DE (net 7.9%) — limiting liquidity buffers.
Loan maturity conditions tightened for a net 11.6% of Slovak firms (n=76), compared with a net 4.4% in the EA and net 3.4% in DE — reducing financial flexibility.
chart_subtitle: Net 43.8% of Slovak firms reported interest rate tightening.
